about_the_game:
Welcome to <<Cyber ​​Rhapsody>>!
This is a game that combines first-person shooting and music rhythm!
The story is set in the cyberpunk world of 2050 in the future. At that time, AI has ruled the world. In order to save energy to supply AI brains, humans have become cheap labor and become miserable workers in the dark factory assembly line. Humans are hypnotized, alienated, and transformed, or lose their minds and become monsters, or are brainwashed to become cannon fodder soldiers, or are transformed by reproduction and digestion to become fixed human meat machines on the assembly line.
Music brings salvation! Music awakens the protagonist's remaining sanity, and he takes up arms to fight to the end!
Holding a shotgun and a Gatling gun, quickly hunt monsters in a psychedelic cyberpunk city!
Press the keyboard buttons at the right time to collect music notes to keep your sanity from being swallowed!
Go! Go! Go!
Destroy everything!
